The Soccer Star Awards is an annual football award presented by Iraqi magazine Mashaher Al Iraq since 2019 to honour the Iraqi players with the best performances in the calendar year.
Overview
The Soccer Star Awards is regarded as Iraqi football's most prestigious and valuable individual award.
